cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: What Are We Now?
cards.instruction: Find out how someone defines the relationship without directly asking for a label.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Do I bring my own towel when I visit now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. The guest towel or the one that's always been mine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours is still on the hook. I haven't moved it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When I leave, shall I hang it back there or put it with the guest laundry?

mechanism: A uses precise household linen instructions to test whether a former personal place still signifies ongoing belonging rather than guest status.
confusable: D57 could seek privilege; D78 uses the towel question to discover B definition of connection rather than demand rank.
comparison: Wedding alternative tests public family inclusion; towel alternative tests whether a familiar domestic place continues after departure.
seedUse: Visit towel, guest towel, personal hook and guest laundry derive from D78-b; S03 adds exact available-versus-allocated and after-use handling corrections.
